text:
sam.wu: Quick sync — ACMEcorp onboarding now targeting Tue 2026-04-12 for tenant activation. Need confirmation on: firewall egress rules, image sync method for air-gapped infra, and CR owner for node-pool scaling. Can owners chime in?

maria.ops: I'm +1 on Tue, but we need final inbound port list from networking. I'll ping net-team. :eyes:

ben-net: Net list draft: 443 (control plane), 80 (pull fallback), 123 (NTP), 9000 (internal prober). We'll need customer firewall change window to apply NAT rules. Link to draft: https://confluence.redwood/net/fw-rules-acmecorp

sam.wu: thx @ben-net — can you own the fw CR? we prefer 02:00-04:00 UTC window (weekday).

ben-net: I can own FW CR. Filing CR-4579 now and will assign to @lina-sec for approval.

lina-sec: noted — I'll review the CR. For air-gapped image sync we require signed images + checksum manifest and attestations. @carla-eng, can image-exporter produce that?

carla-eng: image-exporter v0.9 outputs signed tarballs + sha256 manifest. Only gap: client retry on flaky SFTP. I'll open a tiny PR to add exponential backoff.

sam.wu: please drop PR link here and tag reviewers so we can get it merged before dry-run.

carla-eng: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/image-exporter/pull/201 — requesting review from @amar-dev.

amar-dev: on it, aiming to finish review end of day.

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled for 2026-04-12T02:00Z -> 2026-04-12T04:00Z (owner: sam.wu) :rocket:

maria.ops: Also need confirmation on KMS key access model for customer HSM. @hank-sec? We need import steps validated.

hank-sec: Customer will provide wrapped key blob; we perform unwrap/import into our KMS wrapper. I'll run a dry-run with test certs and document steps with @maria.ops tomorrow.

sam.wu: Outstanding dependencies: fw CR (ben-net), image-exporter PR merged (carla-eng/amar-dev), KMS import dry-run (hank-sec). If all green we run a smoke canary on Tue. Any objections?

emma-support: Support on-call covered that night (me + Josh). We'll watch logs/alerts and run the customer smoke script. Please post playbook link.

sam.wu: playbook: https://confluence.redwood/onprem/onprem-activation-playbook — includes runbook and run commands.

maria.ops: quick checklist in the doc: certs, fw, images, k8s taint/label plan, prometheus scrape endpoints, node-pool autoscale policy. I added owners inline.

ben-net: CR-4579 filed, tentative window set. @lina-sec can you provide approval by EOD Monday so we can finalize scheduling?

lina-sec: I can. Will validate policies and sign off or request changes.

carla-eng: PR merged, commit aad3f4b. Added SFTP retry with backoff.

amar-dev: reviewed and left a tiny nit, addressed — LGTM.

sam.wu: perfect. Scheduling a short pre-flight tomorrow 14:00 UTC to run through playbook and breakout owners. Meeting invite sent. :calendar:

maria.ops: one more ask — customer requested offline logs export for compliance. Who owns the export job?

hank-sec: infra-logging owns exports. @noah-logs can you validate retention and presigned flow for airgap customers?

noah-logs: Yup, we'll validate. Will test presigned S3 flow and local transfer job against a staging airgap node before Tue.

sam.wu: thanks all. if any blocker appears, drop it here. otherwise see you in preflight. :thumbsup:
